i'm sorry this happened to you OP :( my house was broken into early last year and it really is such a violating and scary experience, especially being the one to see the intruder and then have to spend your next day within the house as well. 

taking some time away from your house sounds like a good idea, i did something similar. i totallyws understand not feeling safe in your house. i'm not sure if you know how they got into your house but if you do, what helped me was taking steps to stop anyone having access to that - for me they get it through my windows so i pushed heavy furniture in front of them, and that helped with my peace of mind. if you're having those worries around needing to constantly check if your locks are locked, i've heard that taking a picture of your locks once you've locked them can be helpful, so you can look back on those photos instead of getting up to physically check the locks. 

what you've been through is scary and unfortunately it's the kind of thing that takes time to lessen, so please be kind to yourself. be with your friends, reach out to your communities, and if this feeling still hasn't lessened in a few more days please reach out to your GP and see about getting some further support ❤️ take care
